statement: A school surveyed $50$ students about how many minutes of recreational screen time they had on a school day. The results are shown in the table. $$\begin{array}{c|c} \text{Minutes} & \text{Number of students} \\ \hline 0 \text{ to less than } 30 & 4 \\ 30 \text{ to less than } 60 & 7 \\ 60 \text{ to less than } 90 & 9 \\ 90 \text{ to less than } 120 & 13 \\ 120 \text{ to less than } 150 & 17 \end{array}$$ Using the midpoint of each interval to represent every student in that interval, what is the estimated mean screen time, in minutes?

choices.misconception: I used the left end of each interval, 0, 30, 60, 90 and 120, instead of the midpoints.
I found the interval that holds the median, 90 to less than 120, and gave its midpoint as the mean.
I used the right end of each interval, 30, 60, 90, 120 and 150, instead of the midpoints.

hints: Each interval is $30$ minutes wide. What is the midpoint of $0$ to $30$?
Multiply each midpoint by its number of students, add the products and divide by the total number of students.

solutions.reliable: The midpoints are $15$, $45$, $75$, $105$ and $135$. The estimated total is $4(15) + 7(45) + 9(75) + 13(105) + 17(135) = 60 + 315 + 675 + 1365 + 2295 = 4710$ minutes. The estimated mean is $\dfrac{4710}{50} = 94.2$ minutes.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
